purpose:
On the 16th October 2025 the Children and
Young People Policy Committee authorised the Director of Education
in consultation with the Chair of the Children and Young People
Committee to take all steps required to spend £1.178m of
project funds for the Henbury Court refurbishment project,
including procuring and awarding contracts over the key decision
threshold. The award of a construction contract for the
refurbishment of Block C at Henbury Court Academy will provide
additional specialist educational accommodation and create 30
additional SEND places as part of the Education Capital Programme.
The works are funded through Department for Education High Needs
Provision Capital funding and support the council's statutory
responsibility to provide sufficient school places for children and
young people with special educational needs and
disabilities.
topline: The Director of Education, Inclusion and Skills has decided to approve funding for a new school building project.
